_comment: Universe for the multi-chain dry-run probe (tools/probe-dry-run.mjs --continuous). The token/pair universe is now DISCOVERED on-chain via factory events + Algebra probing (see tools/probe-discovery.mjs), then filtered by TVL. The seed tokens below are only used to bootstrap price lookups (USD valuation of unknown tokens) and Algebra pool probing — they are NOT the observation universe themselves.

42161.name: arbitrum
42161._seed_tokens_comment: Bootstrap tokens for USD pricing + Algebra probing (Camelot factory.pool lookups). Discovery adds the rest.

_filter_comment: Liquidity filter: only observe pools with TVL in this range. Low end avoids dust/scam pools; high end avoids high-liquidity pools where edge is arb-compressed. User-selected target: $10K-$500K (true low/medium liquidity).
_discovery_comment: Factory event sync window. Backfill depth = how many blocks of history to scan at startup (one-time). 100000 blocks ≈ last ~2 months on Arbitrum, ~6 months on Base/Op. Incremental sync after that catches new PoolCreated events.
_crossChain_comment: Tokens to observe cross-chain (Phase 2). Auto-derived from discovered pools: any token that appears on ≥2 chains AND passes the per-chain liquidity filter. This list is a hint for which symbols to map across chains by symbol match (since same token may have different addresses on different chains).
